enabled.label: Enable AI Search on the storefront

results_mode.label: How the results page is served
results_mode.info: "App block": add the "AI Search results" block to your search template (Online Store 2.0 themes). "Search page from the app": the search form is sent to /apps/search, which renders inside your theme (older themes without app blocks).
results_mode.block: App block on the search template
results_mode.proxy: Search page from the app (older themes)

input_selector.label: Search input selector override
input_selector.info: CSS selector for the theme's search inputs. Default: form[action*="/search"] input[name="q"]

form_selector.label: Search form selector override
form_selector.info: CSS selector for the theme's search forms. Default: form[action*="/search"]

predictive_selector.label: Native predictive dropdown selector
predictive_selector.info: Elements to hide so the theme's own suggestions never show. Default covers Dawn and most themes.

native_results_selector.label: Native results section selector
native_results_selector.info: Overrides the selector configured on the AI Search results block.

show_search_form.label: Show a search box above the results

hide_native_selector.label: Native results section selector
hide_native_selector.info: CSS selector of the theme's own search results section, hidden while this block is on the page. Default covers Dawn.

ai_search.no_results: No products match your search. Try another word.
